messages:
leo (sec-eng): Heads-up — getting pTLS handshake errors from proxies in ap-south1 starting ~04:05 UTC. Spike aligns with yesterday's IAM prune job that removed unused bindings. suspect KMS unwrap denies. anyone else seeing?

rina (infra): pulling KMS audit and proxy logs now. which proxy fleet?

leo (sec-eng): internal-proxy-apac and model-edge-apac are top offenders. sample from proxy log:

```
2026-03-23T04:06:12Z proxy-23 WARN tls: client cert unwrap failed: KMS_UNWRAP_DENIED
request_id=abcd1234 source=10.50.9.21 target=proxy-edge-ap-south1
```

leo (sec-eng): and the KMS audit shows permission denies for the proxy SA that was listed as "unused" by the prune job.

jong (sre): nice catch. pinging iam-runbooks. can you paste the audit line?

rina (infra): from cloud logging:

```
protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail: "proxy-apac@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
protoPayload.status: { code: 7, message: "Permission denied: cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt" }
resourceName: "projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/edge/cryptoKeys/proxy-unwrap-key/cryptoKeyVersions/5"
```

alyssa (oncall): the prune job had rule: remove bindings for SAs with no activity in 30d. It mis-evaluated the proxy SA because unwrap activity goes through KMS logs (not tracked by our last-activity query). So it flagged as unused.

leo (sec-eng): so root cause = overaggressive IAM prune that didn't look at KMS unwrap events. short-term mitigation?

alyssa (oncall): I can rebind the SA now. command I used last time:

```
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding proxy-unwrap-key \
  --keyring=edge --location=global \
  --member=serviceAccount:proxy-apac@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
```

alyssa (oncall): rebinding done. I kicked the proxy cert fetch job and seeing success on retries, handshakes returning to normal at 04:14 UTC. :white_check_mark:

jong (sre): good. recommended immediate steps:
- rollback prune change and re-run with KMS-aware activity list
- hotfix prune rule to query cloud audit logs for cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt entries in last 90d
- add temporary alert that maps KMS "Permission denied" to pTLS handshake spike pages

rina (infra): long-term: update prune automation to consult a central "crypto-prereqs" service that knows which SAs need KMS access, and add a dry-run mode that emits diffs to the #iam channel. also add unit/full-integration test that simulates unwrap calls.

leo (sec-eng): other mitigations for proxy resilience?

jong (sre): proxy changes we should do ASAP: 1) fallback to cached unwrapped key for two rotations (with TTL jitter), 2) exponential backoff + jitter for cert fetch to avoid stampede, 3) add short local key cache with soft-fail mode that allows TLS to continue if KMS temporarily denies for <=2m (auditable).

alyssa (oncall): opening incident ticket and scheduling postmortem. will tag infra + sec + sre for follow-ups.

kms-pruner-bot: action: prune-job-2026-03-23 paused by automated safety after 04:20 UTC due to detected KMS denies.

leo (sec-eng): for the postmortem please include: how prune detected activity (fix query), list of affected services, timeline, data to show handshakes -> KMS denies correlation, and proposed fixes. also capture the exact gcloud commands used to rebind.

rina (infra): will add automated check in CI: run faux-unwrap workload against any SA slated for removal. will PR this week.

jong (sre): I'll PR proxy TTL/fallback config and wire the KMS->handshake alert. planning to keep the soft-fail window conservative.

leo (sec-eng): thanks team. closing loop when postmortem draft is up. :eyes:
